name: Quantum ESPRESSO
description: Builds Quantum ESPRESSO 7.6 into /opt/wise: every bundled program, no third-party library unless asked. CPU: GCC, MPI + OpenMP, FFTW, ScaLAPACK, OpenBLAS. With cudaCC: nvfortran with OpenACC, cuFFT, cuSOLVER and GPU-aware MPI, one MPI rank per GPU and no OpenMP, linked only to SDK BLAS/LAPACK and the nvfortran libraries in /opt/wise/nvhpc so GCC's OpenMP runtime never loads.

cudaCC.description: GPU compute capabilities for nvfortran, comma separated (80,90 builds for A100 and H100); requires the CUDA base image. Empty builds the CPU version with GCC.

elpa.description: Use ELPA as the distributed eigensolver; needs the elpa Feature.

hdf5.description: Write wavefunctions and charge densities with parallel HDF5; needs the hdf5 Feature.

cmakeArgs.description: Extra CMake arguments, space separated, applied last.
